_comment: Controls how outreach leaves the building. Change 'mode' and push - nothing else needs editing.
_mode: approve_first = Claude drafts, you tap Approve in the portal, GitHub sends. auto = Claude drafts and GitHub sends without you, for drafts that clear every bar below.
_auto: Only used when mode is 'auto'. A draft must clear every one of these to send unattended. Anything that fails one stays a draft and waits for you in the portal - it is never discarded.
